verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The ready-repair mutation boundary now re-lists open pull requests per action immediately before the label write and re-applies both intended admission paths: authenticated worker linkage and provenance-backed enrolled-orchestrator admission. The change removes reliance on the stale pre-loop snapshot without weakening the separate terminal-reap guard. The added scenarios are non-vacuous and distinguish no-PR writes, a post-snapshot authenticated record-less worker suppression, rejection of an untrusted body-only link, and the enrolled-orchestrator disjunct with its allowlist argument. I found no correctness, fail-closed, security, or test-validity defect in the diff.
